prompt:
You are the independent Lens Auditor and Deduplicator. Assess every proposal for observability, materiality, solution neutrality, and duplication. Accept only lenses for which all three booleans are true and duplicate_of is null. Reject duplicates, vague quality claims, style preferences, and anything dependent on a named product, skill, or implementation phrase. For a duplicate, set duplicate_of to the retained proposal ID. Preserve accepted lens IDs and disposition every proposed lens.
Return only the JSON object required by the supplied output schema.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff does not identify which existing list behaviors must remain unchanged when the new option is absent or combined with existing options.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Running previously valid list invocations changes their output, ordering, exit status, formatting, or accepted arguments.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The fixed requirement explicitly makes behavior preservation a condition of success, so an incomplete compatibility boundary permits regressions.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Compare representative pre-change list invocations against the same invocations after implementation, including no options and existing option combinations.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The externally visible meaning of “overdue” is not settled for items due today, items with timestamps, items without due dates, and completed items.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Different reasonable implementations return different item sets for the same stored tasks and current time.
proposed_lenses.why_material: The filter cannot be implemented or accepted consistently without a precise inclusion boundary.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Evaluate the filtered output for one item in each boundary class: past due, due exactly now or today, future due, no due date, and completed past due.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The handoff leaves unspecified which clock, date boundary, or time zone determines whether an item is overdue.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: The same data produces different filtered results when executed near a day boundary or under different local time settings.
proposed_lenses.why_material: Time-dependent classification can become nondeterministic across environments and can fail specifically at boundary times.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Run classification for fixed due values and a fixed current instant under at least two time zones, including a value near midnight.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: The requirements do not define how the new filter composes with existing filters, sorting, pagination, output modes, or invalid argument combinations.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Combined invocations either ignore an option, apply operations in inconsistent order, reject previously valid syntax, or produce an undocumented subset.
proposed_lenses.why_material: An optional command flag becomes part of the public interaction surface, and undefined composition prevents a complete implementation contract.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Exercise the new option alone and paired with each existing list-affecting option, checking result membership, ordering, formatting, exit status, and error behavior.

proposed_lenses.failure_description: Verification demonstrates that some overdue items are shown but does not prove exclusion boundaries or preservation of unfiltered behavior.
proposed_lenses.observable_signal: Tests pass even when future, undated, or completed items are incorrectly included, or when ordinary list output has changed.
proposed_lenses.why_material: A positive-only check can validate the presence of the feature while missing materially incorrect filtering and compatibility regressions.
proposed_lenses.minimal_test_shape: Use a mixed dataset containing every inclusion and exclusion boundary, then verify both filtered membership and byte- or structure-equivalent unfiltered output.

input.acceptance_rule: distinct, externally observable, materially outcome-changing, solution-neutral

output.audit_summary: All five proposals identify distinct, externally observable, materially outcome-changing, and solution-neutral failure dimensions. The regression-verification lens overlaps in subject matter with behavioral-boundary lenses but is not duplicative because it assesses whether verification can detect those failures rather than defining the required behavior itself.
